---
title: "analyze various coverage cut-offs for genomes/segments per sample"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(wesanderson)
library(tidyr)
library(micropan)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice) # Load eoffice library for PPTX output
library(ggdist)  # For raincloud plot (half-violin + scatter + boxplot)

### Files
virome_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_virome_abundance_table3.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)
metadata_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table3.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)

virome_dt <- fread(virome_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
meta_dt <- fread(metadata_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# Merge virome data and metadata
virome_met_dt <- merge(virome_dt, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID")

# Combine City and Site columns
virome_met_dt$City_Site <- str_c(virome_met_dt$City, ", ", virome_met_dt$Site)

# Calculate coverage and categorize it
virome_met_dt <- virome_met_dt %>%
  mutate(coverage = covered_bases / reference_length) %>%
  mutate(cov_category = case_when(
    coverage >= 0.9 ~ "Over 90%",
    coverage < 0.9 & coverage >= 0.5 ~ "50% to 90%",
    coverage < 0.5 & coverage >= 0.1 ~ "10% to 50%",
    TRUE ~ "Less"
  ))

# Calculate the median number of sequences for each cov_category
median_category <- virome_met_dt %>%
  group_by(sample_ID, cov_category) %>%
  summarize(seqs = n_distinct(sequence_name)) %>%
  filter(cov_category != "Less") %>%  # Filter out the "Less" category
  group_by(cov_category) %>%
  summarize(median_seqs = median(seqs))

# CNS journal color scheme
cns_colors <- c("#00A087", "#4DBBD5", "#E64B35","#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85")
custom_scale <- cns_colors[1:3] # Select 3 colors for the three categories

# Prepare data for plotting
plot_data <- virome_met_dt %>%
  group_by(sample_ID, cov_category) %>%
  summarize(seqs = n_distinct(sequence_name)) %>%
  filter(cov_category != "Less")

# Convert cov_category to ordered factor based on coverage level
plot_data$cov_category <- factor(plot_data$cov_category, levels = c("10% to 50%", "50% to 90%", "Over 90%"))

# Create raincloud plot with correct axes orientation
raincloud_plot <- plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cov_category, y = seqs, fill = cov_category)) +
  # Add half-violin plot (cloud)
  stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5, width = 0.6, justification = -0.25,  # Position cloud to the right
    color = NA, alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  # Add boxplot
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, color = "black",
    position = position_nudge(x = 0)  # Align boxplot with axis
  ) +
  # Add median labels above the boxplot
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = sprintf("%.0f", ..y..)),
    hjust = 1.6, vjust = -0.5, color = "black", size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_scale) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))  # Adjust y-axis expansion
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Genome/segment coverage",
    y = "virus genomes/segments with coverage level per sample"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),  # Horizontal labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Display the plot
print(raincloud_plot)

# Save the plot as a PDF file
ggsave(raincloud_plot, file = sprintf("%s/charts/seq_coverag_per_sample.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), width = 6, height = 5)

# Save the plot as a PPTX file
pptx_filename <- sprintf("%s/charts/seq_coverag_per_sample.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(raincloud_plot, filename = pptx_filename, height = 6, width = 5)
```
